segments.speaker: narrator
segments.name: Narrator
segments.text: November in Shantiniketan. The Poush Mela is coming, but for Protima, the house feels hollow since her husband passed in March.

segments.speaker: protima
segments.name: Protima-di
segments.text: Everything is so quiet without his humming. I cannot imagine making the payesh alone.

segments.speaker: shom
segments.name: Shom
segments.text: Didima, look what I found in this old ledger. Dadu wrote a recipe here.

segments.speaker: protima
segments.name: Protima-di
segments.text: Oh. It was always ours, Shom. He kept the proportions. I just did the tasting. <sigh> We shouldn't bother.

segments.speaker: shom
segments.name: Shom
segments.text: We have to enter. It is for him, Didima. You can't let Haren-kaku win just because he's waiting at the tea shop bragging about his year.

segments.speaker: protima
segments.name: Protima-di
segments.text: Haren-kaku has been trying for thirty-one years. He is a very determined man, Shona.

segments.speaker: shom
segments.name: Shom
segments.text: So let him try. We will be better.
